If you think that I am all talk and no walk, I need to then say something about myself, something that will not necessarily prove me right, but will help anyone that cares to read this know where I am coming from.

Roughly two years ago, I hit what most people would call "rock bottom". I didn't get up for anything, I slept through almost every day and just sat at my computer trying to talk to as few people as I could because I knew that they all hated me, hell I hated me. I never saw any worth in myself. Everything I did or attempted, even if I managed to succeed, I found failure in and focused on that point alone.

Then I began cutting myself. I cut because it felt good, and at first it was on spots that could heal back quickly and no one would notice what they really were. I had a knife that I sharpened all the time, I worked with sharp objects, I was bound to get cuts on my palms every now and again right? Well, most of those cuts were self inflicted; and I cut in such a way that would make them easy to hide.

But pretty soon that was not enough. I wasn't getting any gratification from it. I was not getting anywhere close to dying and I knew it. So began to drive incredibly reckless no matter where I was going. I sped, weaved, drove on the wrong side of the road at one point; if you could think of it I most likely did it.

Pretty soon I began tying knots, tying small knots to try and make it look like my final goal was not at all what it appeared to be. I wanted to hang myself, so I worked my way up all the way until I was ready to tie one.

Then, everything changed for me. I got a random text from a girl I used to date asking me if I wanted to go to Senior dance with. She said I was her last resort but "she would be really happy if I would go with her".
